_about: Watch levels for the sentinel agents. These thresholds are PROVISIONAL choices made for this shadow run so the dashboard can say calm / watch / stress. They are not in the book or the Design Paper and should be reviewed. Sentinels never act; they only report and raise packets for humans.

FIMA_REPO.note: Usage above zero means foreign official holders needed dollars against their Treasuries.

FOREIGN_CUSTODY.note: A fast fall means foreign official holders are selling or repo-ing Treasuries.

DOLLAR_INDEX.note: A sharp dollar rise is the classic sign of an offshore dollar squeeze.

OFFSHORE_CREDIT.note: Context only: the size of the offshore dollar system the transition must survive.

STRESS_STL.note: Stand-in for the design's payment-stress index, which is not yet specified.

STRESS_CHI.note: Stand-in for the design's payment-stress index.

BANK_CREDIT.note: Context only: the credit-standards formula (Ch. 8) has not been written yet, so no threshold is set.

TEN_YEAR.note: Proxy for kill criterion 5 (Treasury yields up more than 3 points and staying there).
